description: Manga/manhwa translation evaluation corpus. Reference Arabic is machine-drafted and NOT human-verified: items are scored for agreement with the reference, never for absolute quality, until promoted by review.

splits.dev: Development split. May be inspected when tuning prompts, glossary and segmentation, and may seed the knowledge base and translation memory.
splits.test: Evaluation split (holdout). Never used to seed the knowledge base, translation memory, research queue or any training data. Enforced at runtime by src/platform/eval/holdout.ts.

reference_provenance.ai_drafted: Reference written by an AI assistant. Comparable across models, but it is not a native-speaker gold standard. Reported as agreement only.
reference_provenance.human_verified: Reviewed by a competent Arabic speaker. Only these items may back a quality claim.

guarantees: test items are rejected by KnowledgeRepository, TranslationMemoryRepository, ResearchQueue and Prewarmer
dataset export filters out test items by default
an evaluation run records the dataset version so results are not compared across corpora
